title: Harden SSH
story: Logging in as root over SSH with a password is how many servers are lost.
goal: In /etc/ssh/sshd_config, set PermitRootLogin to no and PasswordAuthentication to no.

files./etc/ssh/sshd_config:
# sshd_config
Port 22
PermitRootLogin yes
PasswordAuthentication yes

hints: sed -i can replace text inside a file.

Run:
sed -i 's/PermitRootLogin yes/PermitRootLogin no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
sed -i 's/PasswordAuthentication yes/PasswordAuthentication no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
socratic: Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
